## No. IRDA/SUR/MISC/ORD/<>..a.101/2017 

03 rd January 2017 

**Re** : **Appointment of Election Officer to conduct 9th Council Elections of Indian Institute of Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (IIISLA) for 2 All India basis vacancies and 2 Zonal vacancies.** 

> Pursuant to the meeting of the Board of Directors of IIISLA held on 20th February, 2015 at 

> Marriott Hotel, Hyderabad, the following Council Members of IIISLA are due to retire by rotation. 

1. Mr. R K Elango, All India basis. 

2. Mr. Ashok Kumar, All India basis. 

3. Mr. AR.Ramesh, South Zone. 

4. Mr. Mrinal Pathak, East Zone. 

> Accordingly, Authority decided to conduct the 9th Council Elections of IIISLA for 2 All 

> India basis vacancies and 2 Zonal vacancies arising out of the above retiring Council Members. 

Authority hereby appoints Mr.V.Devanathan, Head-Technical & Projects, General Insurance Council as the Election Officer for conducting the 9th Council Elections. Mr.V.Devanathan is advised to take all necessary steps to conduct the election in a smooth and fair manner and in accordance with Articles of Association (AOA) of IIISLA and IIISLA Regulations & Procedure for the conduct of elections to the Council (Election Regulations). IUSLA is hereby advised to extend all co-operation and financial assistance to conduct the elections in accordance with AOA and Election Regulations. 

**(P.J.Joseph) Member (Non Life)**
